## SR07 — exact experiment binding

The missing subject was Quant's existing `experiment_identity_sha256`. Risk bound
strategy/version and caller-controlled wrapper digests, but the exact action and
authorization token did not name the experiment. Valid evidence for Experiment A
could therefore be rewrapped as the current science for Experiment B under the
same strategy/version while the action had no experiment claim to contradict it.

`risk-action` now requires the Quant experiment identity. Before consuming the
one-time scientific commitment, the assembler compares the action against the
authoritative current-state science tuple, assessment and commitment. A mismatch
fails before commitment consumption. The decision binds the experiment, exact
assessment digest and exact commitment digest. The single-use authorization token
repeats and verifies all three plus the decision digest. Ledger obligations also
carry the experiment identity, and exact settlement checks require it.

Owner attacks cover missing/malformed identities, same strategy/version with a
different experiment, action substitution, decision substitution, token
substitution, post-issuance mutation and a fully recomputed assessment,
commitment and state wrapper. All reject. Exact Experiment A science, action,
decision and token remain a positive synthetic PAPER control when every unrelated
control permits it. Quant evidence remains evidence only; it supplies no Risk,
paper, live or operational authority.

## SR08 — semantic reservation uniqueness

The prior ledger prevented duplicate reservation IDs and duplicate action digests,
but a caller could rotate action ID/digest, authorization digest and reservation
ID while retaining the same position and canonical economic subject. Both records
then reserved the same liability.

Each RESERVE now derives `liability_identity_sha256` from account, amount,
position, strategy/version, experiment and canonical strategy/event/market/
selection identities. Cosmetic action, authorization, reservation, settlement
and ledger-event wrappers are excluded from that semantic digest. They remain in
the stricter economic identity used for exact release, settlement and correction.

Ledger replay permanently remembers action digest, position ID and semantic
liability identity even after release or settlement. Wrapper rotation, same
action/position/amount with another reservation ID, changed authorization,
changed amount on the same position, changed experiment on the same position,
post-release recreation and post-settlement recreation all reject. Account
separation remains mandatory. A genuinely new position produces a new liability
identity and can reserve independently, so the fix does not collapse distinct
positions. Existing exact release, settlement, correction and exposure-neutral
settlement behavior remain intact.

## Preserved controls

SR02–SR05 remain unchanged at the production boundary: lifecycle/ledger/kill
current-head checks, canonical authority provenance/revocation/conflict checks,
authoritative STOP inventory/policy/clearance, and PENDING+OPEN canonical exposure
aggregation all retain passing owner and upstream coverage. Exact single-use and
expiry behavior, paper/live account separation, fixed capital sources, M0 denial,
the OPEN STOP and ENGAGED kill switch are preserved.

The historical `tests/test_skeptic_risk_v1.py` and independent
`tests/test_skeptic_risk_v2.py` are byte-identical. Skeptic v2 now reports eight
passes and two expected errors: its SR07 and SR08 unsafe-acceptance
characterizations reach the new production rejections. That owner observation is
not independent closure; H-M0-024 requests a focused successor disposition.

## External limitations and next gate

No production external controller authentication, key custody, hostile-host
rollback resistance, remote durability, venue/execution truth, cross-system
atomicity or complete sports-correlation oracle is provisioned. The local
contracts fail closed when those inputs are absent; they do not manufacture those
guarantees.

`H-M0-024.v1` requests focused independent Skeptic review of the frozen
implementation and evidence. Only that review may close SR07/SR08 or change the
finding disposition. Director retains all later project, STOP and capital gates.
